source_note: PLACEHOLDER adaptive-diagnostic rules. Every number is invented to make the adaptive selector runnable and MUST be checked against pedagogy/product intent before it is trusted (see docs/TO_VERIFY.md).
start_difficulty_why: PLACEHOLDER: begin just below the middle so the first question is not too hard or too easy before any signal exists.
difficulty_step_why: PLACEHOLDER: move one level up after a correct answer and one level down after a wrong one (a gentle staircase).
difficulty_min_why: PLACEHOLDER: never go below the easiest authored difficulty.
difficulty_max_why: PLACEHOLDER: never exceed the hardest authored difficulty.
min_questions_per_topic_why: PLACEHOLDER: every topic gets at least two questions before a diagnostic can stop, so coverage is meaningful.
max_questions_why: PLACEHOLDER: hard cap on a diagnostic session length regardless of coverage.
skip_recent_days_why: PLACEHOLDER: do not resurface the same question the student saw in the last two weeks; avoids memorised repeats.
prefer_untested_misconceptions_why: PLACEHOLDER: when several questions fit, prefer one whose misconception distractor has not been exercised yet, to probe more failure modes.
misconception_bonus_why: PLACEHOLDER: score bonus (in tie-break units) for a question that tests an unseen misconception.
coverage_round_robin_why: PLACEHOLDER: visit topics in a stable round-robin so early topics are not starved by a deep bank on one topic.
stop_when_covered_why: PLACEHOLDER: stop as soon as every topic reaches min_questions_per_topic (unless the bank is too thin).
